description: Declared LV2 deployment inventory for the standard MAP2 host
source: Live MAP2 LV2 runtime inventory aligned with /api/plugins/discover
note: This manifest is the deployment and audit source of truth for the standard MAP2 operator host. Legacy TooB and legacy Dragonfly URI cards may remain in the repo for compatibility, but they are not part of the declared runtime baseline. Instrument-only plugins are declared here for inventory parity even when they are not used by the default audio-effect chain templates.

plugins.name: MVerb
plugins.description: Compact algorithmic reverb with density, damping, and early/late balance controls
plugins.author: Martin Eastwood, falkTX

plugins.name: IR
plugins.description: Convolution-style impulse-response processor with predelay and envelope controls
plugins.author: Tom Szilagyi

plugins.name: Outotune
plugins.description: Mono pitch-correction utility with MIDI mode support
plugins.author: Richard Hladík

plugins.name: Dragonfly Hall Reverb
plugins.author: Michael Willis and Rob vd Berg
